confidence_notes: FX came from one RBA search. The search result gave 0.6677 for 19 Nov 2026 but described that figure as possibly provisional. It also confirmed 0.6720 for 18 Nov 2026, so I used the 19 Nov rate as the latest published figure. Food and drink anchors come from one search of cost-of-living aggregators (Numbeo, Nomad Watch and similar). Those sources are crowdsourced, differ from each other, and some are dated, so the numbers are rough. Resort-area restaurants may charge more than the aggregated figures. Cocktail and wine are not directly sourced. I set them from the local beer price, assuming cocktails cost about 3x beer and wine about 2.5x beer in tourist venues where alcohol is taxed heavily. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates from general knowledge and were not checked against any listings. They are the least certain anchors. Hurghada's resort market is also seasonal.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to Red Sea resort cities such as Sharm El Sheikh and Dahab. Prices are low by international standards, with a tourist premium in resort areas.
